other_conditions: The worker must be registered with the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
The worker must have at least one year of continuous membership with the Board
The worker’s membership must be active at the time of application
The benefits are available only to the children of registered workers
The children must be admitted to or pursuing a B.Tech/equivalent, Polytechnic/Nursing diploma, ITI course, or prestigious institutes such as IIT, IIM, AIIMS in a government institution
benefits_summary: Full tuition fees are covered for prestigious institutes (IIT, IIM, AIIMS) and one‑time cash assistance of up to ₹20,000 for B.Tech/equivalent courses, ₹10,000 for Polytechnic/Nursing diplomas, and ₹5,000 for ITI courses.
